one_line: Ramachandra’s son-in-law who led the final rebellion at Devagiri against late Khalji rule, c. 1313–1317 CE.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean and wiry with a disciplined warrior’s build
appearance.face: oval face with a straight nose, medium-brown Deccan complexion, sharp black eyebrows, a short neatly trimmed beard and moustache, and a steady, intense gaze; default expression is resolute and alert as if weighing strategy in a tense court.
appearance.hair: thick black hair, shoulder-length and slightly wavy, parted in the middle and tucked back; wrapped with a narrow maroon cloth band like a simple Deccan-style headscarf tied at the back, leaving the crown and forehead visible.
appearance.costume: A late-13th/early-14th-century Deccan court-warrior outfit: a knee-length, long-sleeved quilted cotton tunic (padded coat) in deep indigo blue with subtle vertical stitching, worn over a light cream cotton angarakha-style inner tunic whose collar peeks at the neck; a broad maroon cloth sash wraps firmly around his waist, knotted on the left with the loose ends hanging to mid-thigh; below, he wears straight, slightly tapered trousers in muted brown, gathered at the ankles and tucked into simple leather boots in dark brown reaching just above the ankle; over his shoulders is a sleeveless, fitted leather-and-metal lamellar vest in dull steel-grey and brown, composed of small rectangular metal plates laced onto a leather backing, covering his chest and upper back; his forearms bear plain iron bracers strapped over the tunic; he wears minimal jewelry befitting a provincial noble in crisis—small rounded gold studs in both ears and a single thin gold ring on his right ring finger; the overall look is practical, dignified, and era-accurate to a Deccan ruler under Khalji pressure.
appearance.signature: A single straight-bladed Deccani sword (talwar precursor) with a gently flared, disc-shaped iron pommel and a simple crossguard, carried sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard with modest brass fittings, hung from his maroon waist sash and often held in his right hand in a calm but ready stance.

ref_desc: Harapala of Devagiri is a mid-30s, medium-brown, oval-faced Deccan noble with shoulder-length black hair in a maroon headband, wearing an indigo quilted tunic, cream inner tunic, maroon sash, brown trousers, lamellar vest and iron bracers, carrying a straight-bladed Deccani sword in a dark brown scabbard, in an indigo, maroon, cream, brown and steel-grey palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Harapala of Devagiri: a mid-30s, lean Deccan noble-warrior with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, sharp black eyebrows, short beard and moustache, and a resolute, alert expression. His thick black hair is shoulder-length and slightly wavy, parted in the middle and tucked back, wrapped with a narrow maroon cloth band tied at the back, leaving his forehead visible. He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved quilted cotton tunic in deep indigo blue with visible vertical stitching, over a light cream inner tunic whose collar shows at the neck. A broad maroon cloth sash is wrapped tight around his waist, knotted on the left with ends hanging down. He has straight, slightly tapered brown trousers gathered at the ankles and tucked into simple dark brown leather boots just above the ankle. Over his torso sits a sleeveless leather-and-metal lamellar vest in dull steel-grey and brown, formed from small metal plates laced to leather, plus plain iron bracers strapped on his forearms. Show small gold stud earrings and a single thin gold ring on his right ring finger for restrained noble status. His signature weapon is a straight-bladed Deccani sword with a simple crossguard and disc-shaped iron pommel in a dark brown leather scabbard with modest brass fittings, hanging from his maroon sash and also shown unsheathed in one view. Present front, side, and back views to clearly display his face, hair, indigo tunic, cream inner layer, maroon sash, brown trousers, lamellar vest, bracers, boots, and sword, with the dominant colours indigo, maroon, cream, medium brown, dark brown and dull steel-grey.
